question: Seven years ago from now, a man was five times as old as his son. Seven years from now, the father will be three times as old as his son. Find the son's present age.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use elimination by subtracting both conditions

(F+7) − (F−7) = 3(S+7) − 5(S−7)

14 = 3S + 21 − 5S + 35

14 = −2S + 56 ⇒ 2S = 42

**∴ Answer = 21 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let present age of father = F and son = S

7 years ago: F − 7 = 5(S − 7)

7 years later: F + 7 = 3(S + 7)

**Formula used:**

Form linear equations and solve simultaneously

**Calculation:**

⇒ F − 7 = 5S − 35

⇒ F = 5S − 28

⇒ F + 7 = 3S + 21

⇒ F = 3S + 14

⇒ 5S − 28 = 3S + 14

⇒ 2S = 42

⇒ S = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equations

Two equations with two variables can be solved using substitution or elimination method.

Age Difference Concept

The difference between ages of two persons remains constant over time.

Verification Method

Substitute obtained value back into original equations to verify correctness.
